title: cool enough for you
lyrics:
[00:08] I'm sorry
[00:12] I'm not cool enough for you
[00:18] For you to love me too
[00:24] I can't be the one
[00:32] Whenever I wake up, I feel unsure
[00:39] Is this what I've been asking for?
[00:45] You were so divine and beautiful
[00:51] And I'm here looking like a fool
[00:58] I'm sorry
[01:02] I'm not cool enough for you
[01:08] For you to love me too
[01:14] I can't be the one for you
[01:22] Would you let me be around you?
[01:28] 'Cause someone said, I was never meant to be with you
[01:35] I wish I was one inch taller, wish I had those cool tattoos
[01:42] You're out of my league, thats for sure
[01:50] I'm sorry
[01:54] I'm not cool enough for you
[02:00] For you to love me too
[02:06] I can't be the one for you
[02:14] But someday, I'll learn how to
[02:20] Be the one you're looking for
[02:26] I'll be cool enough for you
